subject: Prefer NEON over SVE
perf_evidence: Commit reports NEON performing 25% to 40% better than SVE and changes the default vector-dispatch priority.
change_summary: Changes AArch64 default XXH3 vector dispatch from SVE to NEON when both are available.

units.name: public XXH3_64bits, 256 bytes, AArch64 SVE+NEON default dispatch
units.evidence: Alive2 rejects the old SVE body at llvm.aarch64.sve.ptrue.nxv2i1 in both directions; no refinement comparison is possible for the changed dispatch.

units.name: AArch64 without SVE and x86 unaffected controls
units.evidence: The unaffected AArch64 and x86 XXH64 length-64 control targets pass both Alive2 directions.

notes: The controls do not prove the SVE-to-NEON dispatch change; Alive2 lacks the scalable-vector instruction needed on the old side.
